subject: pathology
title: Non Mendelian inheritance: imprinting, repeats and mitochondria

steps.tx: **Genomic imprinting** silences alleles by parent of origin through methylation: **Prader-Willi syndrome** (paternal 15q11-13 deletion or maternal **uniparental disomy**, hyperphagia with obesity, short stature, intellectual disability) mirrors **Angelman syndrome** (maternal deletion or paternal UPD, severe disability with ataxia, inappropriate laughter, seizures) at the same locus. **Uniparental disomy** (both homologues from one parent) unmasks imprinting or recessive mutations; Beckwith-Wiedemann (paternal 11p15 excess, macrosomia with Wilms risk) inverts the pattern. Methylation testing with FISH sorts deletions from disomy.
steps.say: Same chromosome, opposite parent lost: Prader-Willi eats, Angelman laughs. Both homologues from one parent is disomy.

steps.tx: **Trinucleotide repeats** expand across generations causing **anticipation** (earlier, severer disease): **fragile X** (CGG in FMR1, intellectual disability with macroorchidism and long face; premutations cause **primary ovarian insufficiency** and tremor ataxia syndrome), **myotonic dystrophy** (CTG in DMPK, hatchet face with cataracts, myotonia, cardiac block, congenital severe form), **Huntington disease** (CAG in HTT, chorea with dementia, paternal transmission expands most). Southern blot or PCR sizes repeats; premutation carriers need family counselling before expansion.
steps.say: Repeats growing each generation strike earlier: fragile X, myotonic dystrophy, Huntington. Fathers expand Huntington most.

steps.tx: **Mitochondrial inheritance** passes only through ova (sperm mitochondria discarded), so affected mothers transmit to all children while fathers transmit to none; **heteroplasmy** (mutant load varying by tissue) explains variable severity. **MELAS** (stroke like episodes with lactic acidosis) and **MERRF** (myoclonus with ragged red fibres) strike energy hungry brain and muscle; **Leber optic neuropathy** blinds young men sequentially (covered in neuro ophthalmology wave). Muscle biopsy with respiratory chain assays and mtDNA sequencing confirms; maternal relatives counselled.
steps.say: Mother to all children, father to none: mitochondrial. Mixed mutant loads vary the damage: heteroplasmy.

steps.tx: **Mosaicism** (postzygotic mutation, McCune-Albright with cafe au lait and precocious puberty, segmental neurofibromatosis) and **gonadal mosaicism** (phenotypically normal parent with multiple affected children, as in osteogenesis imperfecta) explain recurrence defying Mendelian ratios. Counselling computes empiric risks: imprinting needs parent of origin testing, repeats need sizing, mitochondria need maternal pedigree, mosaicism needs gonadal sampling debates. Pedigree with molecular testing replaces risk tables.
steps.say: Normal parents with several affected children suggest gonadal mosaicism. Pedigree plus molecules sets recurrence.
